title: A network self-check proves the runner's forge access before an unattended run, and land names a glab that is not signed in
goal: backlog.py selfcheck --network adds a forge check: git ls-remote of the integration remote with autopilot.runner_ssh_command (the runner's deploy key alone) and glab auth status for its host, each failure with its remedy; land prints one line when glab cannot read the merge request instead of saying nothing, so a stuck merge request is told apart from an expired login; today selfcheck is offline and stuck_merge_request returns None silently when glab is not signed in
notes: Theme: credentials. Evidence: bl_selfcheck.py:30-32 the checks are offline; bl_land.py:544-549 stuck_merge_request returns None when glab is not signed in; glab OAuth expired overnight and the runners fell back to polling git by hand (mac-third, mac-fourth, mac-sixth, mac-seventh). Decision D-rvbderx6 already chose a runner deploy key and a minimal project token; this item checks them. mac-fifth proposed an autopilot.py ready aggregate of every pre-run check; this is its forge part.
